name: Differential voltmeter
summary: A differential voltmeter indicates a difference between documented voltage inputs.
description: A differential voltmeter indicates a difference between documented voltage inputs. Its reference and compared circuits must be identifiable so the indicated difference has a defined meaning.
readingNotes: Verify the input connection arrangement against the actual instrument diagram.
